msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. REGLA B: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia lucia-vela-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a green jacquard jacket with black frog fastenings and matching green wide trousers from the reference, walking at the Renaissance square of Úbeda, Jaén, Spain, with golden stone palaces, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia lucia-vela-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a long burgundy satin wrap dress with a leaf print and a tie waist from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia lucia-vela-10.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Product photo of a lilac midi dress with cap sleeves and a belt from the reference, three-quarter front view, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#ECE7E0) background with a soft shadow, crisp embroidery and fabric detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia lucia-vela-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing an olive satin midi dress with a V-neck from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia lucia-vela-04.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a grey jacquard jacket with black frog fastenings from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
